title: intel.search_signal.changed v1 payload
description: Whether search may send hashed query terms for an account (Tara Intelligence WP 8.7-B2, owner decision 7). enabled = search_signal AND NOT personalization_off. Emitted by feed in the preference transaction, behind INTEL_EMIT_R4_EVENTS (default on). Consumer: search (emits search.queried only while enabled).
